questions.question: Tell me about a time you had to make a difficult architectural trade-off
questions.interviewer_intent: Assessing system design thinking and decision-making under constraints
questions.star_blueprint: When migrating our monolith to microservices, I faced a trade-off between consistency and availability. I chose eventual consistency with idempotent operations, which increased complexity but enabled 99.99% uptime.
questions.resume_anchor: Architected microservices migration reducing latency by 60%

questions.question: How would you design a URL shortener that handles 1B requests/day?
questions.interviewer_intent: Testing distributed systems knowledge and scalability thinking
questions.star_blueprint: I'd use consistent hashing for sharding, Redis for caching hot URLs, and PostgreSQL with read replicas. Key design points: base62 encoding, TTL-based cleanup, and geographic routing for latency.
